tei:div.tei:p: "$ (167)༄༅// gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i gsol 'debs sngon 'gro ngag 'don gsum sbyor bzhugs so/// /

(168)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ /gsang chen bde mchog rdo rje 'chang gi thabs lam mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi zab gnad btsan thabs pho nya bde chen shin tu myur lam tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub ba'i gdams pa// gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i sngon 'gro ngag 'don gsum sbyor ni/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sgo gsum dag par byed pa'i rdo rje 'chang*// dngos grub stsol mdzad bla ma rin po che// sngags rnams kun gyi snying po 'bru gsum pa// zab lam chu rgyun gcig ni 'dir 'bad bya// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rwa bsgrub phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje 'chang zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur// oṃ gzugs thams cad rnam par snang mdzad sku rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang grub bar gyur/ āḥ sgra thams cad 'od dpag med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan grub par gyur// hūm̐/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu (169)'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' mdzes pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur// de'i spyi bor gdan bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang yab yum kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bzlas pa gang mang bya// rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin gyi gsol 'debs 'don// de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/

/swa bhā was/ chos thams cad stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'byung bzhi dag pa'i sgyu lus maṇ+ḍal la// a ba dhu ti ri rgyal lhun por brjid// 'khor lo bzhi sogs rtsa rnams gling bzhi'i brgyan// yan lag nying lag bcas pa'i brgyad po 'di// gling phran brgyad du mdzes par yang dag bkod// 'byung 'jug gnas gsum rgyal srid sna bdun (170)'bul// dwangs ma dkar dmar nyi zlas legs brgyan pa'i// 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin chen snying la sogs// bkod legs yid 'ong rin chen maṇ+ḍal 'di// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul lags kyis// lus la bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// rtsa rlung las su rung bar byin= /rlung sems dbu mar tshud par= /rang sems chos skur rtogs par= /'chi med rig 'dzin brnyes par= /'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// gu ru i dam rat+na maṇ+ḍal kaṃ ni r+yā ta yā mi/ /brgyud pa ring brgyud kyi gsol 'debs ni/ /rje na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ /mi 'gyur drug ldan rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// 'ja' lus ting 'dzin mngon gyur sha ba ri// rang lus 'od kyis bskor ba'i bi bhū ti// rang byung gtum mo 'bar ba'i chos 'od zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rtsa yi btsan thabs 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs// rlung gi btsan thabs 'byongs par= /thig le'i btsan thabs= /'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par= /bka' lung man ngag 'dzin mdzad 'phags 'od pa// bstan pa ril por 'dzin pa'i bu ston rje// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mnyam med lo tsā ba// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po grags pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /rtsa yi btsan thabs= /rlung gi btsan thabs= /thig le'i btsan= /'ja' lus mkha' spyod= /kun mkhyen gnyis pa phyogs las rnam rgyal dang*// nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag ras chen pa// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter mdzod mi pham rje// rtsa rlung sems la dbang thob nam lhun zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so=

/rtsa yi= /rlung gi= /thig le'i= /'ja' lus= /mkhas pa'i dbang po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang*// rgyal ba'i sras po nam mkha' 'od zer zhabs// bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan nam mkha' rin chen dang*// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag nam mkha' rgyal po'i zhabs// gsol ba= /rtsa yi= /rlung gi=(171)thig le'i= /'ja' lus= /rdo rje 'chang dngos nam mkha' dkar po dang*// don gnyis mtha' phyin nam mkha' grags pa dang*// 'dus chen rab rgyas 'jam dbyangs dga' ba dang*// bka' drin 'khor med rin chen bzang po'i zhabs// gsol ba= /rtsa yi= /rlung gi= /thig le'i= /'ja' lus= /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i mdzod 'dzin rdo rje 'chang*// thugs rje'i gter chen dge legs rgyal mtshan dang*// gsang sngags zab lam 'chang ba skal bzang mtshan// rje btsun bla ma bstan pa'i gsal byed zung*// bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs// gsol ba= /rtsa yi= /rlung gi= /thig le'i= /'ja' lus= /byin rlabs dngos grub brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// lag len man ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// lung khrid tshig brgyud brjod pa'i bla ma dang*// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma khyed rnams la// gsol ba= /rtsa yi= /rlung gi= /thig le'i= /'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ /rje na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ /sa gsum mnga' bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// bde stong skyed mdzad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lus la bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// 'bar 'dzag dga' bzhi 'byongs par byin= /rang byung lhan skyes rtogs par= /mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag 'jigs med grags// nyams dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid ras chen pa// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter mdzod mi pham rje// rtsa rlung sems la dbang thob nam lhun zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /lus la bde= /'bar 'dzag=

/rang byung = /mkhas pa'i dbang po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang*// rgyal ba'i sras po nam mkha' 'od zer zhabs// bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan nam mkha' rin chen dang*// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag nam mkha' rgyal po'i zhabs// (172)gsol ba= /lus la= /'bar 'dzag= /rang byung= /rdo rje 'chang dbang nam mkha' dkar po dang*// don gnyis mthar phyin nam mkha' grags pa dang*// rlung sems dbang 'dus 'dus chen rab rgyas dang*// 'jam dbyangs dga' ba rin chen bzang po'i zhabs// gsol ba= /lus la= /'bar 'dzag= /rang byung = /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag dge legs mtshan// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed skal bzang mtshan// skyabs kun ngo bo rig 'dzin rnam rgyal dang*// bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs// gsol ba= /lus la= /'bar 'dzag= /rang byung= /byin rlabs dngos grub brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// lag len man ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// lung khrid tshig brgyud brjod pa'i bla ma dang*// rtsa bar brgyud pa'i bla ma khyed rnams la// gsol ba= /lus la= /'bar 'dzag= /rang byung lhan skyes= /srog thur dbang du 'dus par byin= /rlung sems dbu mar tshud bar byin gyis rlobs// 'byung 'jug 'gro 'ong chod par= /rlung sems brtan par thob par= /'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par= /'bras bu longs sku thob bar= /'chi med rig 'dzin brnyes par= /mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /dbang bzhi len pa ni/ /dpal ldan bla ma rin po che// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs// bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// lus la bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba btab pas// bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dpral bar thim/ sku las kyang sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/

lus la thim pas skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag /sku (173)bum pa'i dbang thob// lus rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur// lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*// 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur// dpal ldan bla ma rin po che// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs// bla ma'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs// ngag la nus pa thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba btab pas// bla ma'i mgrin pa'i ā dmar po las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgrin par thim/ zhal nas kyang ā li kā li la sogs pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros// ngag la thim pas skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag /gsung gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ lam gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur// dpal ldan bla ma rin po che/ dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs// bla ma'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs// sems la rtog pa 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba btab pas// bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi snying khar thim/ gzhan yang phyag mtshan rdo rje dril bu ḍā ma ru gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ ga la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ yid la thim pas skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag

/thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ lam pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos (174)sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur// dpal ldan bla ma rin po che// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la gsol ba 'debs// sku gsum dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba btab pas// bla ma yab yum 'od du mer zhu// thams cad rang la thim pas/ rang yang 'od du yal/ tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyur// lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*// 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur/ /bsngo smon ni/ dpal ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i dbang phyug gi /dkyil 'khor rnam bzhir dbang mchog bzhi zhus nas// dri ma rnam bzhi dag nas rgyud bzhi smin// 'bras bu sku bzhi thob par byin gyis rlobs// dge ba gang bsags chen po'i nus mthu dang*// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag gis dbang bzhi blangs pa 'di dag rnams// thams cad yid bzhin du ni 'grub gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rtsa brgyud bla ma 'grub gyur nas/ sogs/ dpal ldan bla ma khyed sku= sogs/ khyed la bstod cing*/ sogs= skye ba kun tu/ sogs= ces sogs bsngo smon shis brjod gang rgyas bya'o// ༈ //gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i khyad par gyi gsol 'debs/ nub dang por sdig sgrib dag par byed pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs ngag 'don las/ pha bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ las ngan sdig sgrib dag par= /ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/

nub bzhi pa'i gsol 'debs/ pha bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ bdag la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ bdag la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye bar byin gyis rlobs// ting nge 'dzin khyad par can bdag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /zhes yun ring du gsol ba drag tu 'debs dgos so// sarba maṅga lam//
